label: rejected

evidence.V1: Reads as a bookcase only from the front/3-4 colour views; the 3/4 silhouette is a solid closed rectangle with a cornice (shelf openings face away) and the top view is a single plain slab.
evidence.V2: Clear: case and cornice (big), three shelves (medium), varied book blocks with gold spine labels (small).
evidence.V3: Straight rectangular carcass and rectangular box books; slight height variation and one tilted book, but overall stiff primitives with little exaggeration.
evidence.V4: Consistent chamfers on cornice, uprights, shelf lips, plinth and book edges catch light in close-ups.
evidence.V5: Clean in all close-ups: books seated on shelves, no z-fighting or pinches at shelf/upright joints.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: one fabric hue (book spines) in 3 values plus cream books, frame wood in 2-3 values, small gold labels; colourways keep the structure.
evidence.V8: One LF_VertexColor material, smooth shading, chamfered edges, book-spine fabric hue + frame wood + gold per furniture spec.
evidence.V9: Anchored, Box collision, CanTouch off, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre; all gates pass.

evidence.V1: Front and three-quarter read clearly as a bookcase thanks to the book rows, but the silhouette is a plain rectangular slab with a cornice lip and the top view is just a board, so it is only readable from the front-facing angles.
evidence.V2: Big frame/carcass, medium shelves and cornice, small book spines with gold bands and varied heights - clear hierarchy.
evidence.V3: Frame is a straight-sided box and the books are uniform upright blocks with only a couple of leaning ones; reads partly stylised but stiff (no taper, chunky feet or tilted/stacked book play).
evidence.V4: Consistent soft chamfers on cornice, posts, shelves and book edges catch light in close_top and close_books studio shots.
evidence.V5: Close-ups of books, plinth and top are clean: no seams, pinches or z-fighting; books sit on the shelves.
evidence.V6: One spine hue in three values plus cream books, wood frame in two values, gold spine bands; colourways swap only the spine hue.
evidence.V7: 964 tris vs medium target 2000: under target.
evidence.V8: One vertex-colour material, kit cream and gold accents, chamfer size consistent with the kit.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: anchored, Box collision, CanTouch off, bottom-centre origin, MeshPart white with vertex colours.

evidence.V1: Front and three-quarter read as a bookcase only through the books inside; the silhouette is a plain tall rectangle with a cornice lip and the top view is a featureless brown slab.
evidence.V2: Big (case), medium (cornice, three shelves, book groups), small (gold spine bands, cream/dark book value variation) hierarchy is clear.
evidence.V3: Cornice overhang and varied book heights/leans help, but the case is a straight box and the books are uniform rectangular blocks with no rounded spines, so it reads partly primitive.
evidence.V4: Consistent chamfers catch light on cornice, side posts, shelf lips and book edges in the top, plinth and books close-ups.
evidence.V5: Books, plinth and top close-ups show clean shading with no pinches, seams or z-fighting; books sit on the shelves.
evidence.V6: Wood frame in 2-3 values, one book hue in three values plus cream books and gold bands; disciplined across colourways.
evidence.V8: Vertex-coloured wood + one fabric/book hue, kit cream and gold accents, chamfered edges match the furniture kit.
evidence.V9: Anchored, Box collision, CanTouch off, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre; A1-A18 pass.

top_fixes: Break the box silhouette: shaped cornice/crest, scalloped side profile or bracket feet so it reads as a bookcase from the side and in silhouette
Push stylisation: lean a book or two, add a toppled stack or small prop, vary book thickness more
Give the top surface some detail (moulding inset or an object) so the top view reads
Break the slab silhouette: add a shaped cornice/crown, stubby feet or a stepped plinth, and slightly splayed side posts
Vary the books more - a stack lying flat, a tilted leaning book, a gap with a small prop - to push the stylised read
Give the frame a slight top-heavy taper or rounded corners so it reads less like a box primitive
Break the box silhouette: shaped/arched cornice or crest, stepped plinth or bracket feet, side-panel cutouts
Round the book spines and add one leaning or lying stack so the books read as books, not blocks
Add a small prop or two (jar, candle) on a shelf for silhouette breakup
